content_analysis.rationale: ViralMint provides structured prompts (INSIGHTS_PROMPT, SEGMENT_ANALYSIS_PROMPT) and schema in AnalyzerAgent, but has zero offline/local analysis capability and requires Bring-Your-Own-Key cloud LLM (OpenAI/Anthropic/OpenRouter). Needs an adapter to inject local LLM or project-managed LLM gateway.

vietnamese_adaptation.rationale: ViralMint upstream has NO Vietnamese adaptation, localization, translation, or terminology mapping capabilities. It only provides a generic English SCRIPT_PROMPT for generating English TikTok/YouTube scripts via cloud LLMs. Vietnamese adaptation must be BUILT as a custom module.

audit_results.explanation: ViralMint only provides an English script generation prompt (SCRIPT_PROMPT) with a generic hint for user to pass translation instructions to an external LLM. ViralMint has no Vietnamese adaptation, translation, or localization engine.
